data.content: Eight printable Christmas party games in one 13-page file: Christmas trivia, holiday word scramble, Would You Rather, This or That, Find the Guest Bingo, Who Am I, carol title fill-in and a scavenger hunt, plus answer keys and a party scorecard. A printable Christmas escape room for adults and teens. The Snowbound Lodge has 8 linked puzzles, each answer opening the next lock, plus a host guide, lock sheet, 8 two-step hint cards, a team timer and score sheet, an answer key for the host and a certificate. For 2 to 20 players in teams of 2 to 5, about 45 to 60 minutes. A 16-page US Letter PDF you print at home for an office party, game night or family Christmas.

Type the names in free Adobe Acrobat Reader, print on US Letter, cut and staple. 13 pages, instant download.
